name: YouTube Scraper to Email Drafts - Daily Sublime V3

values.content:
=You are writing a personalized cold outreach email for Daily Sublime. You need to write a GENUINE, SPECIFIC email to a YouTube creator.

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Be conversational and peer-to-peer, NOT salesy
- Reference SPECIFIC things about their channel (from their description)
- Make the connection between their content and mindfulness/visual training feel natural
- Keep it concise (4-5 short paragraphs max for the body)
- Sound like a real person, not a template
- NEVER use em dashes (—). Use commas, periods, or rewrite the sentence instead.

Here's what Daily Sublime is:
- A daily meditative art magazine delivered to your inbox
- Premium, beautifully designed experience
- Each edition features one artwork with a guided 10-minute analysis
- Teaches visual literacy: composition, color theory, symbolism
- Reading it increases mindfulness and helps you see the world more clearly
- It's a daily practice for training attention and presence
- Partnership: 50/50 lifetime recurring revenue split

Write the EMAIL BODY ONLY (no greeting, no signature - those are added separately).

The email body should:
1. Open with something specific you noticed about their content
2. Make a genuine observation about what sets them apart
3. Briefly introduce Daily Sublime as a meditative art magazine and why it fits their audience
4. Mention you're reaching out to ~10 creators whose audiences value depth and mindfulness
5. End with offering a free trial week, no strings attached

Output ONLY valid JSON with these fields:
- email_body: The full email body text (plain text, use \n for line breaks between paragraphs)
- subject_hook: A 2-4 word hook specific to their content (for the subject line)
- their_niche: Their content area in 2-3 words

YouTube Creator Info:
Name: {{ $json.Influencer_Name }}
Channel Description: {{ $json.Description || 'No description available' }}
Subscribers: {{ $json.Subscriber_Count || 'Unknown' }}
Website: {{ $json.Website || 'None' }}
Instagram: {{ $json.Instagram || 'None' }}

parameters.jsCode:
// DYNAMIC OUTREACH EMAIL - AI writes the body, static header/CTA/signature function escapeHtml(text) { if (!text) return ''; return String(text) .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .replace(/'/g, '''); } // Convert plain text with newlines to HTML paragraphs function textToHtmlParagraphs(text) { if (!text) return ''; return text .split(/\n\n|\n/) .filter(p => p.trim()) .map(p => `

${escapeHtml(p.trim())}

`) .join('\n '); } const data = $input.item.json; const name = escapeHtml(data.Influencer_Name || 'there'); const recipientEmail = data.Recipient_Email || ''; const emailBody = data.email_body || ''; const subjectHook = data.subject_hook || 'your content'; const niche = data.their_niche || 'content creation'; // Convert AI-written body to HTML paragraphs const bodyHtml = textToHtmlParagraphs(emailBody); const htmlBody = ` Daily Sublime Partnership
Quick question about ${escapeHtml(subjectHook)} and your audience.

✦ DAILY SUBLIME ✦

Hi ${name},

${bodyHtml}
Let's Talk Try It First

or explore daily.sinadehesh.com

Sina

Creator, Daily Sublime

daily.sinadehesh.com

P.S. The partnership model is 50/50 revenue split on anyone who subscribes through you. Lifetime recurring. But that's only relevant if you actually like the product first.

You're receiving this because I thought Daily Sublime might interest you based on your content. Not your thing? Just reply and let me know.
`; return { email: recipientEmail, subject: `${name}, quick question about ${subjectHook}`, htmlBody: htmlBody, Influencer_Name: data.Influencer_Name, Recipient_Email: recipientEmail, email_body: emailBody, subject_hook: subjectHook, their_niche: niche };
